prompt: Gameplay screenshot of a cozy mobile farming and village management game, full map overview of an entire Northern Vietnamese village. Strict orthographic isometric camera looking down at 30 degrees, no perspective, no sky, no horizon, no mountains; the map fills the whole frame like a game board. Clear tile-based layout with readable zones connected by dirt paths: the player's home plot with a small red-tile gable-roof house, vegetable beds, chicken coop and well; a village pond with lotus and a wooden pier; a communal house (dinh lang) with a large yard; a small morning market with umbrellas and stalls next to it; a roadside tea and che stall with red plastic stools at the village entrance; a village gate with a low tiled roof; several neighbor houses with red clay tile roofs and yellow lime-wash walls; a banyan tree at the crossroads. A thick bamboo hedge (luy tre) wraps around the whole village. Outside the hedge: green rice paddies divided by narrow dikes, a few haystacks, and a road leading off the map toward the city. Many tiny chibi villagers walking, buffalo in the field, chickens, a bicycle and a motorbike on the road. Clean cel-shaded mobile game assets with soft same-hue outlines, flat bright colors, crisp readable shapes, consistent scale, plenty of empty buildable grass tiles. Authentic Vietnamese details only, no Chinese architecture, no upturned roof corners, no red lanterns, no text.

Mobile game screenshot with a simple HUD, cozy farm and village builder, top-down orthographic isometric view of a whole Vietnamese countryside village, no perspective, no sky, no horizon. The map shows clearly separated gameplay zones on a grass tile grid: a player farm plot with plowed vegetable beds and a rice drying yard, a little red-tile house, a chicken coop, a well; a village market square with striped umbrella stalls; a small roadside shop with red plastic stools; a communal house with a tiled roof; a lotus pond with a wooden pier; a big banyan tree; a bamboo hedge ring around the village; rice paddies and dikes outside the hedge; one locked foggy area at the edge showing it can be unlocked later. Tiny chibi characters, one highlighted player character in a conical hat. HUD: round avatar portrait top left, coin and lotus currency pills top right, a quest card bottom left, four round action buttons bottom right, all icon-only with no readable text. Clean cel-shaded mobile game art, bright warm daylight, soft outlines, flat colors, consistent asset scale, authentic Northern Vietnamese architecture with straight gable roofs, no Chinese style, no red lanterns.
